name: USD/JPY After BOJ Hold Decisions by VIX Regime
description: Event study: How does USD/JPY move after BOJ hold decisions, split by VIX regime? Detects BOJ policy holds via Japan call money/interbank rate (FRED IRSTCI01JPM156N) where abs(rate change) < 5 bps. Splits post-hold USD/JPY paths by VIX regime (High Vol VIX>=18 vs Low Vol VIX<18). Shows 20-day cumulative return paths (spaghetti chart), median forward return bars at +1d/+5d/+10d/+20d by vol regime, and summary stats table with N, median, hit rate, best, worst per regime and horizon.
source:
# USD/JPY After BOJ Hold Decisions — Split by VIX Regime
# Detects BOJ holds via Japan call money rate (abs change < 5 bps)
# Splits by VIX regime: High Vol (>=18) vs Low Vol (<18)
# Measures forward returns at +1d, +5d, +10d, +20d

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# Japan call money / interbank rate (monthly, sparse on daily bars)
jp_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N')()
rate_raw = jp_rate_raw.result
rate_filled = ffill(rate_raw)

# VIX daily via FRED VIXCLS
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')()
vix = ffill(vix_raw.result)

# --- Detect BOJ Rate Decisions ---
# New monthly observation arrives (sparse — fires ~12x/year)
had_new_obs = is_valid(rate_raw)

# Previous observation value (the one BEFORE the current new obs)
prev_rate = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_new_obs, rate_raw)

# Rate change in bps (guard: both must be valid)
rate_change_bps = where(is_valid(rate_raw) and is_valid(prev_rate), (rate_raw - prev_rate) * 100)

# Classify: hold = abs change < 5 bps
is_hold = is_valid(rate_change_bps) and rate_change_bps > -5 and rate_change_bps < 5

# --- VIX Regime at Hold ---
vix_at_hold = where(is_hold, vix)
is_hold_high_vol = is_hold and is_valid(vix) and vix >= 18
is_hold_low_vol = is_hold and is_valid(vix) and vix < 18

# --- Forward Returns on USDJPY ---
fwd_1d = forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# High Vol hold forward returns
hv_fwd_1d = where(is_hold_high_vol, fwd_1d)
hv_fwd_5d = where(is_hold_high_vol, fwd_5d)
hv_fwd_10d = where(is_hold_high_vol, fwd_10d)
hv_fwd_20d = where(is_hold_high_vol, fwd_20d)

# Low Vol hold forward returns
lv_fwd_1d = where(is_hold_low_vol, fwd_1d)
lv_fwd_5d = where(is_hold_low_vol, fwd_5d)
lv_fwd_10d = where(is_hold_low_vol, fwd_10d)
lv_fwd_20d = where(is_hold_low_vol, fwd_20d)

# All holds forward returns (for summary)
all_fwd_1d = where(is_hold, fwd_1d)
all_fwd_5d = where(is_hold, fwd_5d)
all_fwd_10d = where(is_hold, fwd_10d)
all_fwd_20d = where(is_hold, fwd_20d)

# --- Post-Hold Cumulative Price Paths (spaghetti chart) ---
days_since_hold = barssince()(is_hold)

# Only bars within 0-20 day window after a hold
in_window = is_valid(days_since_hold) and days_since_hold >= 0 and days_since_hold <= 20

# Latch the hold-day close, then ffill through the window
hold_close_sparse = where(is_hold, close)
hold_close = ffill(hold_close_sparse)

# Cumulative return since hold (indexed to 0% at day 0)
cum_ret_path = where(is_valid(hold_close) and hold_close > 0, (close - hold_close) / hold_close)

# VIX level on the hold day (latch + ffill for window)
vix_at_hold_sparse = where(is_hold, vix)
vix_at_hold_filled = ffill(vix_at_hold_sparse)

# Vol regime label for path
is_path_high_vol = is_valid(vix_at_hold_filled) and vix_at_hold_filled >= 18
path_label = where(in_window, "High Vol (VIX≥18)" if is_path_high_vol else "Low Vol (VIX<18)")

# Filter to window only
path_ret = where(in_window, cum_ret_path)
path_offset = where(in_window, days_since_hold)

# --- Hit Rate Computation (% positive) ---
# High Vol hit rates
hv_hit_1d = where(is_hold_high_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_1d) and fwd_1d > 0) else 0.0)
hv_hit_5d = where(is_hold_high_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0)
hv_hit_10d = where(is_hold_high_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d > 0) else 0.0)
hv_hit_20d = where(is_hold_high_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d > 0) else 0.0)

# Low Vol hit rates
lv_hit_1d = where(is_hold_low_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_1d) and fwd_1d > 0) else 0.0)
lv_hit_5d = where(is_hold_low_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0)
lv_hit_10d = where(is_hold_low_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d > 0) else 0.0)
lv_hit_20d = where(is_hold_low_vol, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d > 0) else 0.0)

# --- Event marker data ---
rate_at_hold = where(is_hold, rate_raw)
change_at_hold = where(is_hold, rate_change_bps)
vol_regime_label = where(is_hold, "High Vol" if is_hold_high_vol else "Low Vol")

# --- Output 1: CONTEXT — USD/JPY Cumulative Paths After Holds by VIX Regime ---
xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY Path After BOJ Holds: High Vol vs Low Vol',
    category='BOJ Hold Events',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return from Hold Day',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Trading Days After Hold',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    split_by_label=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Hold Day', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=path_offset, y_values=path_ret, label=path_label)

# --- Output 2: PUNCHLINE — Median Forward Returns: High Vol vs Low Vol Holds ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does VIX Regime Matter? Median USD/JPY Return After Holds',
    category='BOJ Hold Events',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Median Return',
    x_axis_label='',
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Blue, stack='High Vol'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='High Vol'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='High Vol'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='High Vol'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Low Vol'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Low Vol'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Low Vol'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Low Vol')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(hv_fwd_1d, hv_fwd_5d, hv_fwd_10d, hv_fwd_20d, lv_fwd_1d, lv_fwd_5d, lv_fwd_10d, lv_fwd_20d))

# --- Output 3: REFERENCE — Summary Stats by VIX Regime ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BOJ Holds — USD/JPY Stats by VIX Regime',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['N (Holds)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Pos)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['+1 Day', '+5 Day', '+10 Day', '+20 Day'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='BOJ Hold Events',
    order=2
)(all_fwd_1d, all_fwd_5d, all_fwd_10d, all_fwd_20d)

# --- Event Markers: BOJ Hold Decisions ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Hold Decision',
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Change (bps)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Level (%)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='+5d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(vol_regime_label, change_at_hold, rate_at_hold, vix_at_hold, all_fwd_5d, is_hold)
